cases.question: companies with more than 1 billion dollars of revenue (absolute USD, cross-market)

cases.question: companies with net debt below zero (net cash)

cases.question: profitable companies whose revenue is still growing (cross-metric)
cases.result_summary: 40 hits. NVDA/GOOG/MSFT/AMZN/AVGO/META — each matched BOTH net_income and revenue.
cases.evidence_check: Each row matched.fundamental has both net_income and revenue keys => AND intersection honored.
cases.confusion_note: Obvious. 'profitable' -> net_income is_positive; 'still growing' -> revenue consecutive_growth.
cases.reason: Two AND-ed fund conditions (profitability + growth) intersected correctly.

cases.question: companies with a dividend yield above 4%
cases.result_summary: Yield-ranked payers returned (total 900+; forward yield_pct). Rich per-stock dividend block (payout_ratio, no_cut_streak, cagr, ffo_payout).
cases.evidence_check: dividend.yield_pct per stock; _guide warns to decompose yield (special-div, payout>1, price-drop trap).
cases.confusion_note: Obvious. Dedicated income screener with min_yield in percent (4=4%).
cases.reason: Dividend yield screen is a first-class tool param.

cases.question: dividend payers whose payout ratio is under 60% and that haven't cut the dividend (dividend safety)
cases.result_summary: total 931. Rows all payout_ratio_eff <0.60 and no_cut_streak_yrs >=5 (SSTK 0.55/5, PFLT 0.33/10 lastcut None).
cases.evidence_check: payout_ratio_eff, no_cut_streak_yrs, last_cut_year all present per row => both safety conditions evidenced.
cases.confusion_note: Obvious. max_payout accepts fraction or percent; min_streak_years = no-cut streak. Dedicated params, no guessing.
cases.reason: Payout ceiling + no-cut streak are dedicated screen_dividends params with per-row evidence.

cases.question: REITs with a high FFO payout (REIT-specific metric)
cases.result_summary: 32 REITs (CCI, MAC, HR, SLG, GFC.PA...) matched ffo_payout via the 'high' top-tail cohort pattern.
cases.evidence_check: matched.fundamental.ffo_payout present but value NOT surfaced ({kind:level} with no numeric value). Leg fired but the FFO-payout number is not echoed as evidence.
cases.confusion_note: Obvious tool path. 'high' (vague, no number) correctly routed to the cohort top-tail pattern, not above/threshold. ffo_payout is a real REIT-specific concept.
cases.reason: REIT-specific FFO-payout concept exists, resolves, and screens on REIT universe. Minor: matched value not echoed.

defects.desc: For the 'high'/top-tail cohort pattern on ffo_payout, matched.fundamental.ffo_payout returns {kind:'level'} with NO numeric value or benchmark — thin evidence vs the below_average case which echoes value+cohort_benchmark.

cases.question: stocks that dropped >15% recently BUT fundamentally fine (growing revenue, not overvalued) — TA cond INTERSECT fund cond in ONE screen
cases.result_summary: 32 hits, ALL tagged matched_legs=[fundamental,ta]. AMSC -28.2%, BIRK -20.7%, BLBD -25.5% drops; each with revenue-growth series and pe below cohort (e.g. pe 10.4 vs benchmark 19.4).
cases.evidence_check: BOTH legs' evidence present per row: ta.'price net drop >=15%'.detail.ret (actual %) + trigger date + strength; fundamental.revenue.series[] + pe.value vs cohort_benchmark. Genuine intersection.
cases.confusion_note: Obvious once axes understood: find_tasignal gives net_change_down (b=fraction 0.15), fund leg AND-ed. 'not overvalued' with no number -> pe below_average cohort (needs no threshold).
cases.reason: Multi-leg TA-INTERSECT-fund worked end to end: rows carry BOTH legs, each leg's numeric evidence present, intersection is real (not a union/OR).

cases.question: companies growing revenue over 20% AND net margin over 25% (two fund conditions AND-ed)
cases.result_summary: 32 hits. NVDA/AVGO/LLY/PLTR/ANET/000660.KO — each matched both revenue and net_margin.
cases.evidence_check: Each row matched.fundamental has both revenue and net_margin keys. Thresholds as fractions (0.20, 0.25).
cases.confusion_note: Obvious. Growth-rate>20% -> revenue compound_growth threshold 0.20; margin>25% -> net_margin above 0.25.
cases.reason: Two AND-ed fund conditions with fractional thresholds intersected correctly.

cases.question: companies whose inventory turnover improved — AND probe an UNSUPPORTED concept (auditor changed)
cases.result_summary: Supported half: 24 hits with dio series evidence. Unsupported half: find_fsconcept returns only weak drift candidates (diluted_accounting_change sim0.66, change_in_dividend_payable) with NO 'no-match' flag; but screen_unified with a bogus concept returns a CLEAR capability error: "unknown concept 'auditor_changed' — not a known field/ratio/valuation metric".
cases.evidence_check: dio matched with series[]. Bogus-concept path = explicit error string, not silent-empty, not crash.
cases.confusion_note: No true inventory_turnover RATIO exists — best proxy is dio (Days Inventory Outstanding, inverse). For 'auditor changed' the RESOLVER gives no confident-match signal (would mislead a blind client into picking a drift candidate).
cases.reason: Unsupported concept DOES get a clear capability error at the SCREEN layer (execution rejects unknown concept). But the find_fsconcept RESOLVER silently returns low-confidence drift candidates with no 'no confident match' flag — a blind client could pick a wrong field. Also no dedicated inventory_turnover ratio (dio proxy only).

defects.desc: find_fsconcept('auditor changed') returns only weak-similarity drift candidates (top sim ~0.66) with NO explicit 'no confident match / unsupported concept' signal — a blind client is nudged toward a wrong field (e.g. diluted_accounting_change). The hard capability error only appears later at screen_unified execution.
No inventory_turnover ratio concept; only dio (Days Inventory Outstanding) as an inverse proxy — client must know to invert 'improved'.

cases.question: resolve five at once: gross margin, interest coverage, quick ratio, tangible book value, effective tax rate (batch)
tool_calls: find_fsconcept(queries:[gross margin,interest coverage,quick ratio,tangible book value,effective tax rate])
cases.result_summary: 5 blocks in input order. #1: gross_profit, interest_coverage, quick_ratio, tangible_book_value, effective_tax_rate.
cases.evidence_check: results[] length 5, one block per query, each with top-k candidates.
cases.confusion_note: Obvious via the `queries` batch param. 'gross margin' top-1 is gross_profit field (ratio gross_margin lower in list) — top-k design, not a defect.
cases.reason: Batch concept-resolution handled all five in one call, correct order, clean top candidates.

top_defects: find_fsconcept has no 'no-confident-match / unsupported concept' signal: a genuinely unsupported concept ('auditor changed') returns only weak drift candidates, so a blind client is nudged to a wrong field. The clear capability error only fires later at screen_unified execution (unknown concept). Resolver should flag low-confidence/no-match.

screen_unified 'high'/top-tail cohort pattern on ffo_payout returns matched value as {kind:'level'} with NO numeric value/benchmark echoed — thinner evidence than the below_average path (which echoes value + cohort_benchmark).
No dedicated inventory_turnover ratio concept (only dio / Days Inventory Outstanding as an inverse proxy).
